related_people.name: Delilah
related_people.role: the woman Samson loved here, bribed to pry out the secret of his strength

description: Home of Delilah, the woman Samson loved who was bribed by Philistine rulers to discover and betray the secret of his strength (Judges 16:4-20).
family_friendly_summary: The Valley of Sorek was the home of Delilah, the woman Samson loved. Philistine leaders offered her a large amount of silver to find out the secret of Samson's great strength. She kept asking until he finally told her, and that led to his capture.
